statusDefinitions.tested: Executed by the release CI matrix and supported for production use.
statusDefinitions.supported: Supported for production use and covered by the stated compatibility range.
statusDefinitions.experimental: May be evaluated, but is not a production support claim.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: Rejected where AgentWorks can detect it; no execution or migration is attempted.

eolPolicy.rule: A supported dependency remains supported through its upstream security-support window. Removal is announced at least 90 days before an AgentWorks minor release; a dependency that reaches upstream EOL may be removed in the next AgentWorks minor release. Security emergencies may shorten notice with a published advisory.
eolPolicy.oldStateRule: Removing an executable version never repins existing runs. Non-quiescent cohorts require their exact compatible reader, executor, adapters, checkpoint/event upcasters, pending contracts, and runtime-owned resources until PostgreSQL proves quiescence. Unsupported old state is quarantined with a typed blocker.
eolPolicy.retirementRule: Runtime compatibility ends only after durable quiescence and irreversible cohort retirement. Audit, replay, legal-hold, retention, privacy-safe idempotency tombstones, and backup readers remain for their independent retention periods.

framework.upgradeRule: Upgrade only as one reviewed dependency change after the complete Spring AI compatibility suite passes; adapter changes must not move framework/provider types outside adapter packages or change durable authority semantics.

experimental: H2 2.5.250 for loopback local development and tests only
unsupported: H2 in a reachable or production installation

dockerEngine.note: Docker or an API-compatible engine must support Compose v2, BuildKit attestations, read-only filesystems, health checks, and the resource/security controls used by the supported packaging.

unsupported: browsers without EventSource, fetch, Web Crypto, or ES2022 support

runEvent.unknownTypeOrVersion: reject; use an explicit contiguous upcaster before support is claimed

mcp.unknown: SDK negotiation rejects before tool discovery or invocation

database.migrationPolicy: forward-only and immutable after a v* release tag
database.unknown: newer schema or incompatible migration state refuses startup

mixedWorkers.rule: A worker may claim only state its stamped compatibility identity can read and execute. It must quarantine incompatible work before claim/commit; it never substitutes the current release or changes creation pins.

deprecations.rule: Every deliberate deprecated-API use must record an owner, tracking issue, removal release, and replacement. Unrecorded suppressions fail the repository policy gate.
